description:
Research five medications on NIH DailyMed (https://dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/): Metformin Hydrochloride, Lisinopril, Atorvastatin Calcium, Omeprazole, and Sertraline Hydrochloride. 

1. Download the official drug label PDF for at least two of these medications to ~/Downloads/.
2. Create a bookmark folder named 'Medication Reference' and add the DailyMed page for each of the 5 drugs to it.
3. Create a JSON reference file at ~/Documents/medication_reference.json with keys 'metformin', 'lisinopril', 'atorvastatin', 'omeprazole', and 'sertraline'. For each, include: 'brand_name' (any valid brand), 'drug_class', 'ndc' (one valid NDC), 'indication', 'boxed_warning' (boolean), and 'boxed_warning_summary' (string, or null if none).
